claims.text: When nitrates and phosphates from fertiliser run-off or sewage enter a slow-moving water body, algae grow quickly and form a bloom on the surface; the bloom cuts off light, so submerged plants die; decomposers, mainly aerobic bacteria, feed on the dead material and respire, which uses up dissolved oxygen; fish and other aerobic organisms then die from lack of oxygen.

claims.text: Alien species can spread fast where their natural predators, parasites and competitors are absent; they compete with native species for light, water and space, so native species decline, and some change the habitat itself.
